requirements.summary: Remove all checkup-related UI elements from the Home dashboard page
acceptanceCriteria: The Home dashboard no longer displays checkup-related tiles or sections
All checkup navigation elements are removed
The dashboard layout remains functional after removal

file_operations.description: Remove checkup-related tiles, sections, and navigation elements from the Home dashboard. Preserve existing health metrics tiles (heart rate, steps, hydration, calories) and other quick action tiles. Ensure the dashboard layout remains clean and functional after removal.

requirements.summary: Remove any checkup-related routes, pages, or components from the frontend application
acceptanceCriteria: All checkup-related routes are removed from the router configuration
All checkup page components are deleted

file_operations.description: Remove checkup-related route definitions from the TanStack Router configuration. Ensure all remaining routes (Welcome, SignIn, SignUp, Home, Profile, Chat, Report) continue to work correctly.
Delete the checkup page component if it exists. This file may not exist if checkups were never fully implemented.
Delete the checkup components directory and all contained components if they exist. This directory may not exist if checkups were never fully implemented.

requirements.summary: Remove checkup-related references from the assistant brain command interpreter
acceptanceCriteria: Assistant no longer recognizes or responds to checkup-related commands
Medical knowledge base does not reference checkups

file_operations.description: Remove checkup-related command patterns, route targets, and navigation logic from the command interpreter. Preserve all other command patterns for navigation, medical knowledge lookup, report analysis, and help responses.
Remove checkup-related entries from the medical knowledge base if they exist. Preserve all other medical topics (blood pressure, diabetes, etc.) and their associated information.
